description: Call BEFORE installing a skill or skill pack from GitHub. Pass the repo and the skills the user already has (name + description, e.g. from your own skill listing). Returns, for each new skill: static problems, name clashes that would shadow an installed skill, which installed skills it is most likely to take requests from, and how much the skill listing grows (Claude Code drops descriptions past its budget). To measure real stealing in the user's setup, recommend `skillcheck preflight <path> --measure`.

github_url.description: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> of the skill(s) to install

name: preflight_skill
